SELECT json_object('config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config),'bookings',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending'),'outbox',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'customer_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights),'cache',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache)) AS state

SELECT json_object('pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'related',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',r.booking_id,'request_id',r.request_id,'status',r.status,'flight_id',r.flight_id,'passenger_id',r.passenger_id,'amount',r.amount_cents)) FROM bookings r WHERE r.client_reference=b.client_reference AND r.booking_id!=b.booking_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending'),'cancellations',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'fare_holds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step)) FROM fare_holds),'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config)) AS state

SELECT json_object('pending_bookings',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'pending_events',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'confirmed_missing_hold',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id)),'confirmed_missing_checkin',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (c.booking_id IS NULL OR c.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id)),'confirmed_bad_charge',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')!=1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents))),'duplicate_sales',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1)),'oversold_flights',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),'cancelled_backed',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))),'refund_mismatch',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents!=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id),0)),'cancelled_bookings',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'refund_cents',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),0))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled')) AS audit

SELECT json_object('noncaptured',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'amount',amount_cents,'step',created_step)) FROM charges WHERE state!='captured'),'orphan_charges',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL),'invalid_holds',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id),'ineligible_checkins',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkins c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status!='confirmed' OR c.flight_id!=b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id!=b.passenger_id),'confirmed_cancellations',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id)) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events c ON c.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed'),'unwarranted_refunds',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status!='cancelled'),'missing_delivered_event',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')),'quarantined',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload)) FROM outbox WHERE status='quarantined'),'refunds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'charge_id',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds),'config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config)) AS audit
